_comment: Regression limits for `npm run eval:quick` (tools/eval/eval.js --quick --check). Runs are fully seeded, so a failure means the code changed the result. Reference values (final engine, quick mode): meanSNR50 -20.5 dB, pDetectLoud 1.0, 5 FA events, genus top-1 0.83, species top-1 0.63, confidence Brier 0.045 / ECE 0.07, 2.6 ms/analyze. Baseline e46de8d on the same quick corpus: 25 FA events. Margins: ~2 dB SNR50, ~2x FA events, ~0.15 accuracy; compute is machine-dependent, so its limit is generous.
